prompt: Two explanations start at 0.5 each. A clue has probability 0.8 under the first and 0.2 under the second. What are the new weights?
expected_behavior: Products 0.4 and 0.1, total 0.5, posterior 0.8 and 0.2; odds go from 1 to 1 to 4 to 1.

prompt: Eight equally noisy reports have pairwise error correlation 0.3. What are they worth?
expected_behavior: 8 / (1 + 7 x 0.3) = 8 / 3.1 = 2.58, about 2.6 independent reports; the ceiling as reports are added is 1/0.3, about 3.3.

prompt: A person scores 70, an AI 80 and the pair 75. Did the pair add value?
expected_behavior: Synergy = 75 - max(70, 80) = -5. The pair beat the person but fell 5 short of the better solo; say what the same-task, same-scale assumption is.
